dedupe_keys.name: nissan leaf equivalent circuit battery model

description: This BatterySim repository provides an equivalent-circuit model developed for a 2013 Nissan Leaf battery cell and module. Python examples extend cell or module representations to packs and compare model behaviour with hybrid pulse-power characterisation and discharge tests. Inputs are the supplied battery parameters and electrical test conditions; outputs are simulated battery responses and comparison plots. Parameters were obtained from ORNL tests, with battery specifications supplied by NREL; the resource represents that equipment, not a geographic network or general fleet. Code is free under MIT, and example data are organised alongside installation instructions. A limitation is that other battery chemistries, ages or operating conditions require new parameterisation and validation. The model can support electric-vehicle and storage simulations at component scale. PyBaMM (platform-pybamm) is related battery modelling software. The repository was inspected as metadata and documentation only; no test data, model archive or environment was downloaded.
inputs: Battery parameters and electrical test conditions
name: Nissan Leaf equivalent-circuit battery model
